Signals Separated in I-PDU ComSignal / ComGroupSignal are not allowed to overlap each other.
Byte Aligned Array Signals ComSignal / ComGroupSignal of ComSignalType UINT8_N and UINT8_DYN shall be byte aligned ( ComBitPosition is a multiple of 8).

Update Bit Excluded in case of Transmission Repetitions For I-PDUs with transmission mode DIRECT or MIXED with ComTxModeNumberOfRepetitions greater or equal 1 no update-bit ( ComUpdateBitPosition ) shall be configured.

Signal Group Gateway Configuration It shall not be allowed to configure signal groups for routing with data type differences between receive and transmit signal group. A sub-setting of signal groups (as defined in [SWS_Com_00735]) shall be supported.
Post Build Configuration Update The post-build time configuration part (post-compile and post-link time) can only be updated when it is not in use.

Float and Array Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals with ComSignalType FLOAT32 , FLOAT64 , UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN , the AUTOSAR COM module shall only support ComFilterAlgorithm configured to ALWAYS , NEVER or ONE_EVERY_N .
Routed Signal Size Configuration The ComBitSize of a received and to be routed ComSignal shall not differ.

Unique COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any two of the following parameters to have the same value: • shortName of a ComSignal • shortName of a ComSignalGroup • shortName of a ComGroupSignal 230 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • shortName of a ComIPdu • shortName of a ComIPduGroup

Well-formedness of COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any of the following parameters not to be formulated according to C’s identifier rules: • shortName of a ComSignal • shortName of a ComSignalGroup • shortName of a ComGroupSignal • shortName of a ComIPdu • shortName of a ComIPduGroup • ComUserCallbackName

Boolean Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals with ComSignalType configured to BOOLEAN , the AUTOSAR COM module shall only support ComFilterAlgorithm configured to: • ALWAYS • NEVER • MASKED_NEW_EQUALS_X • MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_X • MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_MASKED_OLD • ONE_EVERY_N
Mapping of Array Signals A ComSignal / ComGroupSignal of type uint8[n] shall always be mapped to an n-bytes sized ComSignal / ComGroupSignal .

Transmission Mode Configuration Every ComTxModeTrue or ComTxModeFalse that is a potential result of the configured / calculated TMS must be configured. Within the ComTxIPdu , at least one of the containers ComTxModeTrue or ComTxModeFalse has to be included.
Mandatory ComTxIPdu for TX I-PDUs A ComTxIPdu container must be included if ComIPduDirection is configured to SEND .
ONE_EVERY_N Filter Configuration For the ComFilterAlgorithm ONE_EVERY_N , the ComFilterOffset shall be configured to a value lesser than ComFilterPeriod .
OPAQUE Endianness of Array Signals A ComSignal / ComGroupSignal of type uint8[n] shall be configured to have OPAQUE endianness.

TP I-PDUs Excluded from Gateway A signal or signal group contained in an I-PDU with ComIPduType configured as TP shall not be configured as source or destination within the ComGwMapping configuration container.

Callback Names Differ from COM Model Element Names It is illegal for any of the ComUserCallbackName parameters in all ComUserCallback containers to have the same value as any of the following five parameters • Com_<shortName of a ComSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComSignalGroup > • Com_<shortName of a ComGroupSignal > • Com_<shortName of a ComIPdu > • Com_<…
Dynamic Length Signal Configuration A dynamic length I-PDU shall contain at most one dynamic length signal.
Placement of Dynamic Length Signals The dynamic length signal shall be placed last in a dynamic length I-PDU.
Size Configuration of Dynamic Length Signals The ComSignalLength parameter shall be configured to the maximum size / length for dynamic length signals.

Transfer Property of Zero Length Signals The AUTOSAR COM module shall not support the transfer properties TRIGGERED_ON_CHANGE and TRIGGERED_ON_CHANGE_WITHOUT_REPETITION for signals and group signals with ComBitSize configured to 0.

Zero Length Signal Filter Algorithm Limitations For signals and group signals with ComBitSize configured to 0, the AUTOSAR COM module shall not support the filter algorithm MASKED_NEW_DIFFERS_MASKED_OLD .
Bit Size of Signals The ComBitSize of a (group) signal shall not extend past the size of its configured ComSignalType .

Interpretation of Signal Initial and Invalid Values The configured string of ComSignalInitValue / ComSignalDataInvalidValue shall be interpreted according to the definitions of [19] for the boolean and all numerical types.

Signal Invalid Value Configuration In case a ComSignalDataInvalidValue is configured for a ComSignal that is included in a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE , the ComDataInvalidAction shall also be configured for this ComSignal .

Group Signal Invalid Value Configuration In case a ComSignalDataInvalidValue is configured for at least one ComGroupSignal of a ComSignalGroup that is included in a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE , the ComDataInvalidAction shall also be configured for this ComSignalGroup .
Direction of I-PDU Groups All I-PDUs that are contained within one I-PDU group shall have the same ComIPduDirection .
Meta Data Default Item Configuration The number of ComMetaDataDefaultItem containers of a ComIPdu shall match the globally configured number of MetaDataItems of this I-PDU.
Signal User Configuration Sent signals or signal groups shall be owned by a single Software Cluster only and consequently either by Com users of RTE, or SwCluC, or one CDD.
Large Data Path I-PDU User Configuration Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00001 Sent I-PDUs with ComIPduLargeData set to true shall be owned by at most one Com user.

Large Data Path I-PDU User EcucPartition Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00002 All Com users registering notifications for I-PDUs with ComIPduLargeData set to true shall reside on the EcucPartition on which the COM module handles the related I-PDU.

Large Data Path I-PDU Restrictions If ComIPduLargeData is set to true then the following restrictions apply for the ComIPdu : • ComIPduHandleId shall be configured • ComIPduSignalProcessing shall be IMMEDIATE 234 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • exactly one ComSignal shall be referred via ComIPduSi…

Large Data Path I-PDU Excluded Features If ComIPduLargeData is set to true then the following parameters and containers shall not be configured for the ComIPdu : • ComIPduCallout • ComIPduCancellationSupport • ComIPduTriggerTransmitCallout • ComIPduMainFunctionRef • ComIPduSignalGroupRef • ComMainFunctionRouteSignalsRef • ComMetaDataDefaultItem

Large Data Path TX I-PDU Excluded Features If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection SEND , then the following parameters and containers shall not be configured for the ComTxIPdu : • ComTxIPduClearUpdateBit • ComTxIPduUnusedAreasDefault • ComTxModeFalse • ComTxModeTrue

Large Data Path Signal Restrictions If ComSignal is referred by a ComIPdu with ComIPduLargeData set to true, then the following restrictions apply for the ComSignal : • ComSignalType shall be set to UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN • ComSignalEndianness shall be set to OPAQUE

Large Data Path Signal Excluded Features If ComSignal is referred by a ComIPdu with ComIPduLargeData set to true, then the following parameters and containers shall not be configured for the ComSignal : • ComBitSize 235 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 • ComDataInvalidAction • ComHandleId • ComInitia…

Large Data Path Excluded from Gateway If ComSignal is referred by a ComIPdu with ComIPduLargeData set to true, then ComSignal shall not be configured as source or destination within the ComGwMapping configuration container.

Large Data Path Excluded Signal Callbacks If ComSignal is referred by a ComIPdu with ComIPduLargeData set to true, then the following ComUserCallbackType values shall not be configured for the signal: • COM_RX_ACK • COM_RX_INV • COM_RX_TOUT • COM_TX_ACK • COM_TX_ERR • COM_TX_TOUT

Large Data Path TP Transmission Callbacks Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00009 If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection SEND and ComIPduType TP , the respective <ComUser_ComCbkCopyTxData> , <ComUser_ComCbkTpTxConfirmation> notification callbacks shall be configured too.

Large Data Path TP Reception Callbacks Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00010 If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE and ComIPduType TP , the respective <ComUser_ComCbkStartOfReception> , <ComUser_ComCbkCopyRxData> , <ComUser_ComCbkTpRxIndication> notification callbacks shall be configured too.

Large Data Path NORMAL Reception Callbacks Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_CONSTR_00011 If ComIPduLargeData is set to true for a ComIPdu with ComIPduDirection RECEIVE and ComIPduType NORMAL , the respective <ComUser_ComCbkRxIndication> notification callback shall be configured too.
